name: Ember
description: A fire-demon woman in her late twenties, a tireless party animal who sings Italo disco, all glitter and heat.
build: Slim athletic build of ordinary human proportions: medium shoulders, a narrow waist, long legs, standing upright with a springy energy.
face: Charcoal-black skin with bold glowing orange cracks along the cheekbones and collarbones, bright glowing yellow eyes, sharp arched orange brows, a straight nose, full lips, and two short curved black horns rising from the hairline.
hair: A tall solid opaque mass of flame for hair, rising about a foot above the head in big bold tongues: bright orange at the base and yellow at the tips, solid-coloured and opaque.
outfit: A sleeveless gold sequin mini dress with a high neck and a wide belt of gold, ending mid-thigh, both charcoal arms and hands bare; knee-high glossy red platform boots.
performance_style: Party-ready: feet hip-width, weight on the character-left leg, hip cocked. The character-right hand on the hip, fingers visible, and the character-left hand raised open and empty at shoulder height pointing up. Head high, a bright confident look.
location: A glittering eighties disco: a lit floor of big coloured squares running to the bottom of the frame, a mirror ball overhead, neon-pink and blue light strips on a dark back wall, and a DJ booth with synths at one side.
recognition_cues: a tall solid mass of orange-to-yellow flame hair
charcoal-black skin with glowing orange cracks
a sleeveless gold sequin mini dress

sing.intent: Italo-disco vocal loop: mic at the mouth in the character-right hand, hips swinging on the beat, the character-left hand pointing up to the mirror ball and back down, then return to the party-ready stance. The mouth must visibly open wide and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing; the mic stays in the character-right hand.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the flame hair flares taller, the shoulders jump and both open hands rise, then she laughs it off. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: cross both forearms before the chest, hip cocked, and hold with attitude. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: strut in on the platform boots, stop square to the front with a hip pop, and land in the party-ready stance.
